customVariables.firstEmail:
Hi Svetlana,

In your paper in the Review of Public Personnel Administration, developmental feedback from supervisors made civil servants more likely to take charge, through a stronger sense of constructive responsibility. It made me wonder whether the same holds when students get feedback on their work, and what changes when part of that feedback comes from AI.

That second question sits close to the online session we're hosting at Eduface, The Business Outcomes of AI Marking and Feedback, with several universities joining. It's on Thursday 15 October, 12:00 to 13:00 Amsterdam time, on Teams.

Registration is by invitation, and the link is below.
